metadata.description: Exhaustive static catalogue of UI event translation, active view routing, vtable dispatch, and CJAPFButtonEventParam lifecycle.

entries.name: OnActionConfirm
entries.rationale: Primary item selection handler in menu navigation tree

entries.name: OnActionNavRight
entries.rationale: Traverses deeper into menu hierarchy at 0x90077512

entries.name: OnActionNavLeft
entries.rationale: Delegates to slot +0x130 with left navigation context

entries.name: OnActionNavUp
entries.rationale: Delegates to slot +0x130 with vertical up navigation context

entries.name: OnActionNavDown
entries.rationale: Delegates to slot +0x130 with vertical down navigation context

entries.name: OnActionMenuBack
entries.rationale: Exits active menu page or toggles menu display state

event_param_lifecycle.lifetime_details: Param object is instantiated dynamically via factory 0x9012B82A during CMENUController::ProcessEventQueue. It is passed synchronously down the dispatch chain in register r2. Immediately upon return from InvokeButtonDispatch (0x90032AF8), the destructor is invoked at 0x90032C86 and memory is released. Asynchronous modules must copy value payload (param + 0x0C) rather than storing the pointer.

proven_facts: TBB1 at 0x90252DAA decodes 59 raw codes into 40 logical IDs (1..28 and 33..44) and routes unmapped codes to 0x90252E56.
TBB2 at 0x9025A86E routes all 40 logical IDs to target 0x9025A8D2 which calls slot +0xC4 and then slot +0x40.
TBB3 at 0x90254E1C routes logical IDs 1..28 to distinct vtable slots +0x120..+0x184 on active view.
CMENUTopMenuView vtable (0x9151D874) populates all slots +0x120..+0x184 with concrete ROM functions.
CJAPFButtonEventParam is allocated in ProcessEventQueue (0x90032C18/0x90032C46) and destructed at 0x90032C86 immediately after InvokeButtonDispatch returns.
GPIO Type-2 transport (0x9011DD5C / 0x9011E756) is decoupled from this queue and routes via dynamic RAM table 0x10319D2C.
inferences: Slot +0x12C (Logical ID 0x01) functions as Confirm / OK / Action selection based on menu execution hierarchy.
Slots +0x130, +0x134, +0x138, +0x13C (Logical IDs 0x05..0x08) function as 4-way Navigation (Right, Left, Up, Down).
Slot +0x17C (Logical ID 0x1B) functions as Menu Toggle / Back based on menu page transition routines.
unproven_boundaries: Physical switch/pin mapping for raw input codes 0..58 is UNPROVEN from firmware disassembly alone.
Vendor semantics of action slots +0x140..+0x178 and +0x180..+0x184 remain UNPROVEN.
The multi-byte meaning of record.value_1 in CJAPFButtonEventParam offset +0x0C is UNPROVEN.
